subject: Request to reschedule our upcoming call
text: I am writing to ask whether we might move the call originally planned for Thursday afternoon. A conflict has come up in my schedule, and I do not want to attend in a distracted way. I recognize this affects several people, and I appreciate the flexibility it may require. I checked the options for the following week, and I have availability on Tuesday morning, Wednesday afternoon, and Friday after two days of preparation. Those times are meant to give the group a chance to review the project notes again before speaking. Since this message arrives after two days have passed since the last update, I wanted to be careful about suggesting times that are too soon. I have attached the draft outline for the call, so anyone can suggest changes before we speak. The main question remains how to balance the next tasks while the feedback is still fresh. I would rather discuss it together than assume a direction on my own. That choice should remain open until we hear from everyone. A reply would help when convenient. Let me know which option works best, or whether you would prefer to keep the original time if the conflict is minor. If moving the call creates a problem for anyone, I am open to an earlier short meeting to confirm the agenda and then use the longer session only if needed. I hope this change is not inconvenient, and I thank you for your understanding.
